alex: quick poll — UX review: pipelines delete flow. put 3 variants in the file: soft-trash (moves to Trash w/ undo), hard-delete modal (typed confirm), and two-step remove (confirm + secondary approve). link: https://www.figma.com/file/abc priya: i lean toward soft-trash for regular users. gives recoverability and reduces panic. we need clear language: 'Move to Trash — recoverable for 30 days' rather than 'Delete'. alex: agreed. downside: Trash adds extra mental model for users who expect immediate deletion. for compliance-sensitive datasets we probably need hard-delete. theo: for hard-delete, typed-confirm works but it's heavy. consider alternatives: checkbox "I understand" + require ENTER key to confirm (keyboard affordance) or a dropdown to select reason to make them pause. rachel: accessibility considerations: if we do typed confirm, ensure the input has label and instructions are available via aria-describedby. also make sure error messages are reachable via skip links. priya: for inline validation across the create form — proposal is showing inline errors under fields, and a compact top summary that appears only when there are 3+ errors. is that ok? theo: yes, show summary only when many errors. summary should list fields and allow keyboard focus to jump to first invalid field (use anchor or JS focus). short copy in-line, no long sentences. alex: copy suggestions: inline: 'Required' or 'Enter a name (3-100 chars)'; top summary: '3 errors — review required fields' with a link to each. rachel: required marker strategy: prefer explicit '(required)' on long forms, asterisk on dense lists. we mustn't rely on color. also add aria-required on inputs. priya: microcopy for undo snackbar: 'Pipeline moved to Trash. Undo' — include time window 'Undo (30s)'. role="status" for the snackbar for screen readers. theo: also a product note: if user has automated jobs pointing to the deleted pipeline, warn about downstream failures in the modal — show a small list of affected jobs. alex: good call. for hybrid rule: if resource flagged sensitive OR deletion affects >1 downstream job OR user selected >3 items, show hard-delete modal. otherwise soft-trash. rachel: can we add a tiny code snippet for aria-live + focus move? rachel: snippet:
Pipeline moved to Trash.
// on error summary click: document.getElementById('field-name').focus(); priya: ok — next steps: i'll update figma with labels + copy variants, theo will draft accessibility checklist items, alex will add the downstream-impact section. design-bot: reminder: add 'keyboard-only flow' and 'voiceover' to PR checklist for this component. :memo: alex: thanks — let's do a quick hallway test after figma update.
